payload.body_they: {{Name}} tends to become known as the person who acts when everyone else is still waiting for somebody to decide what happens next. Their initiative can make people trust them with visible responsibility, especially when something is difficult or urgent. The complication is that handling pressure well tends to attract more pressure. More responsibility should bring more authority, influence, support, recognition, or something meaningful they can actually build with.
